title: plan.json
description: One EVA plan: its identity and every input that fixes its results (D40, D41). It sits at the root of a plan bundle (zip) and is also served alone by the backend. Results (route, timeline, fields) are in the bundle's other files; plan.json holds no result numbers except the storm anchor t* that D39 derives from the route.
x-source: SPEC §11 D40, D41 (set A, 17:16-17:24); handover page 'EVA simulation module' parts A, D; contracts/bundle/README.md

schema_version.description: contract version of this file (the bundle family's x-contract-version)

plan_id.description: stable id; precomputed plans use '{pad id}.{scenario id}', e.g. 'rank1.nom_104'; the backend may use its own ids

title.description: human label, e.g. 'Official pad · nominal · 104 kg suit'

origin.description: D40: 'precomputed' = built from the committed pipeline outputs (part of the validated scorecard); 'computed_live' = made by the backend on request

origin_label.description: the text shown with the plan: 'precomputed, part of the validated scorecard' or 'computed live, not part of the validated scorecard' (D40)

pad.description: the rover parking spot the EVA starts and ends at; also the origin of the pad-local frame

kind.description: official = D21 rank-1 pad; picker = a ranked option from scenarios/pads/index.json; custom = a backend pad

id.description: pad id (official: pad.json pad.id, e.g. 'rank1'; picker: the scenarios/pads/{id} folder)

elev_m.description: pad elevation, m above the Mars areoid (WS1 height datum); z = 0 of the pad-local frame

scenario.description: the engine scenario = physiology variant x suit mass

stations.description: station ids in visit order (route legs pad -> stations[0] -> ... -> pad); empty = no route

eva_start.description: D31: the simulated EVA starts at 09:00 LMST on the EVA sol

storm_replay.description: D39 shared storm timing (config/conditions.yaml storm_replay): the 20 May 2024 RAD storm series is shifted so its tripwire fires at EVA minute t* (the route's largest T_home). storm_utc(eva_min) = tripwire_utc + (eva_min - t_star_min) min

t_star_min.description: EVA minute the tripwire fires at (WS2 engine/summary.json routes.{scenario}.dose.t_star_min); null = no route

storm_utc_at_eva_start.description: storm-series UTC shown at EVA minute 0 (pipeline/conditions/storm_replay.py storm_offset_utc)

engine.description: the simulator compares these with GET /api/v1/engine/version and refuses a mismatched bundle (handover part D)

commit.description: git commit of the engine run that produced the plan's results (manifest 'commit' of its route file); may end in '-dirty'

config_hash.description: sha256 over config/*.yaml sorted by file name, each as utf-8 name, NUL, raw bytes, NUL (contracts/bundle/README.md)

created_utc.description: when the plan's results were computed: the newest manifest time among its input files (deterministic; not the zip time)

world.description: the shared world pack this plan was built against

dummy.description: plans are never built from dummy data
